The default case throws an `IllegalArgumentException` with a message indicating the unknown dialog ID. This exception is a runtime exception (unchecked), meaning the programmer did not need to declare it or handle it explicitly. The intent is to catch programming errors where an invalid dialog ID is supplied, as `onCreateDialog` is typically called internally by the Android framework via `showDialog(int)`. The programmer expects that only valid IDs will be used; the exception serves as a fail-fast mechanism to indicate a bug in the caller's code.
